verdict.rationale: A government tax service with a developer API portal could plausibly offer a public sandbox, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that a GST Developer Portal exists with Register and Login pages. Nothing documents a sandbox, test environment, or end-to-end trial of the API rail before production.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production
